frozen_baseline: Official window 2025-01-01..2025-06-30. All ch_* verdict, ranking and portfolio tables are computed on this frozen window and must NOT be recomputed when the UI filters dates. Date filters apply only to daily/weekly/monthly grains listed under date_filterable.
reconciliation_rule: Totals for any filtered period must be ratio-of-sums from the daily grain (prepared_daily_view / property_day). Never average daily ratios; never mix carded (player) and all-play (machine meter) denominators.

manager_bottom10.units: USD (aggregate observed house win, active days)
manager_bottom10.limitations: includes 2 machines retired during the window

machine_investigation.drilldown: prepared_daily_view by machine_id x gaming_date (bank_id, zone_id available)
machine_investigation.validation: machine house win reconciles to machine_day cents; council agreement
machine_investigation.limitations: location, configuration and player mix are confounded in theo per hour

replacement_candidates.limitations: best case assumes the best title ever observed in the zone; none positive at planning value

floor_demand.source: ch_floor_demand_monthly, ch_floor_demand_weekly, ch_zone_demand, ch_zone_traffic, ch_demand_explanations; daily: property_day
floor_demand.grain: month / week / zone x month / day
floor_demand.units: USD coin-in and theo; entries per covered hour (sensor crossings)
floor_demand.limitations: traffic counters count crossings, offline hours are missing not zero

downtime_economics.grain: month x manufacturer x zone; local hour
downtime_economics.units: hours; USD theo at risk; USD contribution at risk
downtime_economics.validation: meter downtime == ticket outage hours (Step 2 R12)
downtime_economics.limitations: theoretical opportunity at risk, not guaranteed lost revenue

player_outcomes.grain: window summary; tier; tier x month
player_outcomes.units: USD (tracked play; player sign: net = payout - coin-in)
player_outcomes.limitations: carded play only (65.8% of coin-in); guest-group aggregates only, no individual rows exported

loyalty_comps.units: points; USD comp cost and face value
loyalty_comps.date_semantics: ledger events mapped to gaming dates
loyalty_comps.validation: comp cost == ledger economic cost (counted once)
loyalty_comps.limitations: face value is menu price, not revenue; cost is inside POS cogs

council_audit.validation: every claim reproduced by the deterministic verifier

portfolio_comparison.units: USD over Jul 1-30 (cost, modeled contribution, net, low/high)
portfolio_comparison.limitations: modeled, not realised; ranges reflect stated assumption bounds only

forecast_validation.grain: subset; holdout day; run; method x statistic x mode
forecast_validation.date_semantics: train Jan-Mar, validate Apr, holdout May-Jun (frozen)
forecast_validation.validation: Step 5 gates (41 PASS, 1 cross-env FAIL recorded)
forecast_validation.limitations: metrics differ across SciPy/NumPy versions; decisions agree

evidence_lineage.limitations: causal effects not identified are labelled as such
